metadata.title: What if Luffy NEVER ate a Devil Fruit?
metadata.description:
Luffy pursues his pirate dream without rubber powers and must learn rescue, crew dependence and a different fighting style.

Original hypothetical comedy and commentary. Fan-made alternate scenario; events and dialogue are invented, not canon. AI-assisted narration: Kokoro am_michael. Sound effects: Brackeys, public domain.

#Shorts #Anime #WhatIf #OnePiece

sound_repair_source.title: What if Luffy NEVER ate a Devil Fruit?
sound_repair_source.premise: Luffy pursues his pirate dream without rubber powers and must learn rescue, crew dependence and a different fighting style.
sound_repair_source.distinctive_development: Remove powers without erasing ambition; swimming gives one advantage but fists lose protection; teamwork and equipment become necessary; no automatic victory claim.

versions.revision_reason: Owner requested 61-second final cuts and YouTube-side optional music; shorten narration, preserve earlier attempts and reuse frozen footage
